summary: Feeling constantly drained, sluggish, or physically exhausted.

nutrients.name: Iron
nutrients.role: Helps red blood cells transport oxygen throughout the body.
nutrients.pro_tip: Pair iron with Vitamin C (e.g. lemon juice) to boost absorption.

nutrients.name: Vitamin B12
nutrients.role: Crucial for nerve function and cellular energy production.
nutrients.pro_tip: If plant-based, look for B12-fortified plant milks.

summary: Involuntary muscle twitches, spasms, or sudden soreness.

nutrients.name: Magnesium
nutrients.role: Regulates muscle contraction and nerve signals.
nutrients.pro_tip: Magnesium glycinate is easier on the stomach than oxide.
